title: A' - Premium machine hall, finish corrected
summary: contained_hall with the finish bay's landing pad dropped from hall_deck to hall_deck_dark. The pad is the one bright surface behind the finish machine - 27.8% of the final-approach frame at luma 51 against V26's 20-luma ravine floor - and it is the whole of the delta: no geometry is added, no material key is new, and the hall's architecture, radius, rhythm and lighting are V27's unchanged
